name: Y2K Equalizer + Visualizer
overview: A 2000s-inspired equalizer and visualizer for Jellyfin Web.
description: Adds a ten-band equalizer and Winamp, Windows Media Player, and iTunes-inspired visualizers to Jellyfin Web playback.

versions.changelog: Fixes visualization when Jellyfin already owns the Web Audio source and adds double-click fullscreen visualization.
Adds an installable Jellyfin 12 server plugin and catalog manifest for the Y2K Equalizer + Visualizer.
